subject: Re: Kickoff: pretraining for irregular time series
body: Status. PhysioNet-2012 repro: done, and the headline result holds — pretraining with geometric masking lifts mortality-prediction AUROC to 0.852 vs 0.839 for the scratch-trained baseline, with the gain widening (+2.5 AUROC points) in the 10%-labels regime, which is the story that matters for adoption. The cached mask banks work as advertised: sampling from the pre-generated set instead of generating per-iteration cut step time about 35%. Dataset status: MIMIC-III access cleared April 28 and Maren's pipeline is converting it now; eICU is still in the approval queue (as predicted), so the mid-May comparison will run PhysioNet + MIMIC-III + H&M. One technical wrinkle: the imported STraTS modules needed the smart_cond shim from TF 2.12 to run on our stack — Kaia has the fix documented. Leaderboard: Saoirse has ingestion working end-to-end against the eval harness; ranking UI in review. — Freya
